items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Lawarge's Restaurant was Chic Webb, and his wonderful orchestra, and a little 17-year-old girl named Ella Fitzgerald.

ctx.x: He was at that New England bandstand where all the musicians played.

He had everything. That was our, with Artie Shaw, that was our twice a week, we worked out of the Roseland Ballroom, next door to me which I had missed along the way just then, was next door to us, and Lawarge's Restaurant was Chic Webb, and his wonderful orchestra, and a little 17-year-old girl named Ella Fitzgerald.
